slides.p: Five details are enough. A model trained on ADEME’s public energy ratings estimates your class from A to G, and explains why.
G homes can no longer be rented out since 2025, F from 2028, E from 2034. Knowing your class means planning the work ahead.
It picks up your simulation result and answers your questions from official documents.

items.text: A LightGBM model trained on ADEME’s public energy ratings in the PACA region, updated for the 2026 DPE reform. It gives the most likely class, calibrated probabilities and the criteria that weighed most.
A RAG pipeline that searches reference documents (Mistral embeddings), then writes the answer with Claude Haiku or Mistral Small, one or both side by side, and shows the excerpts it used.
It analyses your situation, prioritises the work, prices it and finds the grants you may qualify for.

about.title: Making the DPE <acc>understandable</acc> for every homeowner.
about.lead: Open data, machine learning and generative AI, brought together in one tool.
about.approach: EnergyHome AI combines ADEME’s open data, a <acc>machine-learning</acc> model and a conversational assistant to help everyone understand their home’s energy performance and <acc>plan their renovation.</acc>

bricks.d: Energy ratings published as open data by ADEME, cleaned and stored in PostgreSQL, with labels recalculated for the January 2026 DPE reform.
A LightGBM classifier, trained on ratings from the PACA region, predicts the DPE class from the home’s characteristics; its probabilities are calibrated (isotonic regression).

A RAG pipeline: semantic search (Mistral embeddings), then answer generation with Claude Haiku (Anthropic) or Mistral Small (Mistral AI). In Compare mode, both models get exactly the same passages and their answers are shown side by side.

The design, text, logo and code of this site belong to their author unless stated otherwise. DPE data comes from ADEME and is reused under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0. Full sources are listed on the Credits page.
Simulator estimates and assistant answers are indicative. They replace neither an official DPE, produced by a certified assessor, nor the advice of a France Rénov’ adviser.
Simulator: the home’s characteristics (area, period or year, type, heating, postcode). They are used to compute the estimate and are not linked to any identity.
Contact form: name, email, optional company and message, used only to reply to you.

Your questions are sent to Mistral AI (France) to find relevant passages, then, depending on the model you choose, to Anthropic (Claude, USA) or Mistral AI (Mistral Small, France) to write the answer; in Compare mode, to both. If you run the recommendations agent, your home’s characteristics and estimated class are sent to Anthropic to write the recommendations. Do not enter personal data.
Contact messages are kept for at most three years after the last exchange, then deleted.
No advertising or analytics cookies. Fonts are hosted on the site: no data is sent to Google Fonts.
You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to {email}. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
